# Tosome Logis (투삼로지스)

> Freight forwarder and international courier agent based in Incheon, South Korea. Specializes in lithium battery and dangerous goods shipping, small-lot LCL sea freight (from 0.1 CBM), and single-box international courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS/EMS agent). No minimum order. Ships worldwide from Korea, and handles imports into Korea from China, Vietnam, and other countries.

## Core services

- International courier (DHL/FedEx/UPS/EMS agent, discounted rates): https://tosomelogis.kr/express.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/express.html
- Dangerous goods & lithium battery shipping (IATA DGR compliant, UN number classification, MSDS/DGD preparation): https://tosomelogis.kr/dangerous.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/dangerous.html
- Sea & air freight forwarding (LCL from 0.1 CBM, FCL, customs clearance): https://tosomelogis.kr/forwarding.html | https://tosomelogis.kr/en/forwarding.html
